verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.144
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.144

verses.pali: 15. Tikaṇḍakīvagga
verses.english: 15. At Tikaṇḍakī

verses.pali: Tikaṇḍakīsutta
verses.english: At Tikaṇḍakī

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sākete viharati tikaṇḍakīvane.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāketa, in Tikaṇḍakī Wood.

verses.pali: Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants,

verses.pali: “bhikkhavo”ti.
verses.english: “Mendicants!”

verses.pali: “Bhadante”ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Venerable sir,” they replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a mendicant would do well to meditate from time to time perceiving the following: the repulsive in the unrepulsive,

verses.pali: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyya.
verses.english: the unrepulsive in the repulsive,

verses.pali: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ appaṭikūle ca paṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī vihareyya.
verses.english: the repulsive in both the unrepulsive and the repulsive, and

verses.pali: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyya.
verses.english: the unrepulsive in both the repulsive and the unrepulsive.

verses.pali: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ paṭikūlañca appaṭikūlañca tadubhayaṁ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyya sato sampajāno.
verses.english: A mendicant would do well to meditate from time to time staying equanimous, mindful and aware, shunning both the repulsive and the unrepulsive.

verses.pali: Kiñca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyya?
verses.english: For what reason should a mendicant meditate perceiving the repulsive in the unrepulsive?

verses.pali: ‘Mā me rajanīyesu dhammesu rāgo udapādī’ti—
verses.english: ‘May greed not arise in me for things that arouse greed.’

verses.pali: idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyya.
verses.english: A mendicant should meditate perceiving the repulsive in the unrepulsive for this reason.

verses.pali: Kiñca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyya?
verses.english: For what reason should a mendicant meditate perceiving the unrepulsive in the repulsive?

verses.pali: ‘Mā me dosanīyesu dhammesu doso udapādī’ti—
verses.english: ‘May hate not arise in me for things that provoke hate.’ …

verses.pali: idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyya.
Kiñca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca appaṭikūle ca paṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī vihareyya?
verses.english: For what reason should a mendicant meditate perceiving the repulsive in both the unrepulsive and the repulsive?

verses.pali: ‘Mā me rajanīyesu dhammesu rāgo udapādi, mā me dosanīyesu dhammesu doso udapādī’ti—
verses.english: ‘May greed not arise in me for things that arouse greed. May hate not arise in me for things that provoke hate.’ …

verses.pali: idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca appaṭikūle ca paṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī vihareyya.
Kiñca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyya?
verses.english: For what reason should a mendicant meditate perceiving the unrepulsive in both the repulsive and the unrepulsive?

verses.pali: ‘Mā me dosanīyesu dhammesu doso udapādi, mā me rajanīyesu dhammesu rāgo udapādī’ti—
verses.english: ‘May hate not arise in me for things that provoke hate. May greed not arise in me for things that arouse greed.’ …

verses.pali: idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyya.
Kiñca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca paṭikūlañca appaṭikūlañca tadubhayaṁ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyya?
verses.english: For what reason should a mendicant meditate staying equanimous, mindful and aware, shunning both the repulsive and the unrepulsive?

verses.pali: ‘Sato sampajāno mā me kvacani katthaci kiñcanaṁ rajanīyesu dhammesu rāgo udapādi, mā me kvacani katthaci kiñcanaṁ dosanīyesu dhammesu doso udapādi, mā me kvacani katthaci kiñcanaṁ mohanīyesu dhammesu moho udapādī’ti—
verses.english: ‘May no greed for things that arouse greed, hate for things that provoke hate, or delusion for things that promote delusion arise in me in any way at all.’

verses.pali: idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca paṭikūlañca appaṭikūlañca tadubhayaṁ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyya sato sampajāno”ti.
verses.english: For this reason a mendicant should meditate staying equanimous, mindful and aware, shunning both the repulsive and the unrepulsive.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
